propositions: server.json's top-level description field (190 chars) exceeds the MCP Registry's 100-character limit, causing the publish step to fail with a 422 Unprocessable Entity error during release

the MCP Registry schema constraint is not validated locally by existing CI guards (scripts/check_server_manifest.py, release_guards.py, make lint), allowing the violation to reach the live registry only after PyPI publish (irreversible)

a new guard function check_mcp_registry_description must be added to scripts/release_guards.py and wired into release.yml's Authorize release source job to catch this class of failure before PyPI publish in future releases
server.json's top-level description must be shortened to ≤100 characters while keeping pyproject.toml's longer form unchanged (no lockstep requirement between the two)
the new guard requires unit test coverage in tests/unit/test_release_guards.py and a CLI subcommand mcp-registry-description in release_guards.py to enable real validation in the workflow
